title: Autofill Check
description: Catches browser and password-manager autofill putting the wrong value in the wrong field by detecting fills (the :autofill animationstart hook plus a no-typing batch heuristic), outlining and listing them for review, flagging an email in Name or an address that differs from the account with a one-tap fix, and holding the first submit.
stops: Autofill put email in name field
